Ferry Fire Off Philippines Leaves at Least Five Dead, Dozens Missing

A fire aboard the MV June Aster ferry near Coron, Philippines, has resulted in at least five confirmed deaths, with reports indicating between 80 and 87 passengers unaccounted for. Rescuers are searching for the missing individuals. The incident occurred off the western coast of the Philippines. Among the rescued passengers were two Chilean nationals. The cause of the fire has not been stated in the coverage.
